<?php
namespace App\Billing;

use App\Models\Invoice;

final class InvoiceService extends BaseService implements Billable
{
    use Loggable;

    public const TAX = 0.2;

    private array $cache = [];

    public function __construct(private Repository $repo)
    {
        secretConstruct($repo);
    }

    public function total(Invoice $invoice): float
    {
        return secretTotal($invoice);
    }

    protected static function round(float $amount): float { return secretRound($amount); }
}

enum Status: string
{
    case Paid = 'paid';

    public function label(): string
    {
        return secretLabel($this);
    }
}

function helper(int $x): int
{
    return secretHelper($x);
}

$callback = function ($y) {
    return secretCallback($y);
};
?>
</body></html>
